datalayer-pycompany12d71877d477b93f3ee68ebdc542560ba85997b9S1=endpoint S2=any S4=eitherINTEROP_ALLOW_TEST_HOSTS=1: a Reactor URL-safety contribution (adapter, not a patch) lets the Company fetch client metadata and JWKS from *.interop.test hosts on private addresses; other hosts keep the SDK's public-address policy; Trusts the per-run CA at /interop/ca.pem for those fetches (the adapter builds the httpx client the SDK is given); Organization domain and issuer come from INTEROP_ORIGIN instead of manzanita.example
pi-poppycompany11ea10630180740f16ccd507b8f90f69870c7e32S1=endpoint S2=any S3=either S4=either S23=per-companyPI_POPPY_INTEROP_PRIVATE_SUFFIX=.interop.test (patches/0001): client_id and jwks_uri under .interop.test may resolve to private addresses; unset by default, loopback still refused; CompanyServer's request handler is served on plain HTTP behind the proxy with baseUrl set to the interop origin, instead of its own 127.0.0.1 HTTPS listener; The interop CA is trusted through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS (CompanyServer's `ca` option is left unset)
poppy-democompany02a9b304e92fdfee465c57f2822742eecac8bdc8S1=endpoint S2=jwt-60s S4=omitINTEROP_PEER_SUFFIX=.agent.interop.test (patch 0001): admits any HTTPS client_id under *.agent.interop.test besides the sibling agent, fetched over the network rather than the CALLER service binding; its jwks_uri must share the client_id origin. Off (unset) by default.; With INTEROP_PEER_SUFFIX set, API and conversation requests identify the client by the token owner record instead of comparing with the sibling client_id (patch 0001).; Runs under plain wrangler dev with our wrangler.interop.jsonc instead of the upstream cf beta CLI config; no service bindings.; Trusts the run CA via the system store (update-ca-certificates) for workerd outbound fetches.
poppyseedcompanyf479fb6bd1754b9639440515f259e01936b0a18aS1=endpoint S2=any S3=either S4=eitherfixtures/next-app hard-wires dev.allowInsecureClients: true (upstream, not a patch): http and private-address client_ids are accepted and metadata is fetched with the platform fetch, not safeFetch, so the proxy's private IP is not refused; POPPYSEED_TEST_HOOKS=1 serves poppyseed's own test hooks at /test-hooks/{hook} (upstream, off by default); POPPYSEED_BASE_URL (from INTEROP_ORIGIN) sets the public origin (upstream setting); patches/0001-interop-hooks.patch, on only with POPPYSEED_INTEROP_HOOKS=1: two extra test hooks, interopEndAllSessions (end_sessions with no id) and interopConversation (propose_operation reads the operation the Company Agent proposed)
ilmercompany4ca76e0026a1fa442f9430eddba61e82e6e4c9b4S1=token-endpoint S2=jwt-60s S3=either S4=omitRuns under wrangler dev with a container-only wrangler.jsonc (upstream deploys with the cf CLI): ORIGIN is the interop origin, LOCAL_DEV=false; No Workers AI binding (as upstream's ILMER_POPPY_OFFLINE=true): every Company Agent reply is Ilmer's fixed "Sorry, I could not answer that just now" message; workerd trusts the run CA through the system trust store, installed by the entrypoint, for fetching client metadata
adonis-agoracompany97838853c44e55c5d4c71ac5741f26fc34f720dcS1=either S2=any S3=either S4=omit S23=per-companypersonalAgents.poppy.allowInsecureClientIds (upstream dev/test setting, off by default, refused with NODE_ENV=production; on only with INTEROP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PEERS=1): agent metadata and JWKS are fetched without the SSRF guard (the grid proxy has a private address), and http:// client_ids are also accepted; NODE_ENV=development (required by the setting above); Container trusts the run CA (/interop/ca.pem) through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and the system store; require_nonce flips AuthKit's personalAgents.poppy.dpop.requireNonce at runtime until /reset; rate_limit: endpoint "token" arms AuthKit's own Session limiter (new Sessions only); otherwise the host app answers 429 on its /api/* routes; expire_tokens sets expires_at in AuthKit's auth_poppy_tokens; end_sessions sets ended_at in auth_poppy_sessions (AuthKit has no API for either); /reset replaces AuthKit's cached agent metadata and JWKS (PoppyService.registry) so a peer that rotated its keys is accepted at once; Host app written for the grid: in-memory test accounts, plain-HTML login and consent screens, a scripted model (FakeModelProvider) as the Company Agent, memory stores
